new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Signals Q2 Upside, Renewable Diesel Boost at Investor Day
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 profitability with combined adjusted EBITDA of $406.8 million, including $151.2 million from Diamond Green Diesel, signaling a turning point driven by late-March RVO and improving renewables margins. Management highlighted the Renewable Volume Obligation as a major policy tailwind, with 2026 and 2027 annual demand requirement of 5.4 billion gallons compared with 3.35 billion gallons a year earlier.

new_news.headline: Garbage Truck Market to Reach USD 24.8 Billion by 2035 as Electric Fleets, Smart Automation, and Sustainable Waste Collection Transform Municipal Infrastructure
new_news.summary: Global garbage truck market projected to grow from USD 15.9 billion in 2025 to USD 24.8 billion by 2035. Manufacturers integrating AI-driven fleet telematics, robotic lifting systems, electric propulsion, and advanced compaction to improve collection efficiency and meet environmental regulations.

new_news.headline: WEF Winter Meeting - May 11-14, Kansas City
new_news.summary: WEF Winter Meeting in Kansas City featuring key volunteer committees and programming development for WEFTEC. Provides opportunity for water professionals to convene on biosolids management, PFAS, resource recovery, and advanced treatment technologies.

new_news.headline: New Way and Hyzon Unveil North America's First Hydrogen Fuel Cell Refuse Truck at WasteExpo
new_news.summary: New Way Trucks and Hyzon unveiled North America's first hydrogen fuel cell-powered electric refuse truck at WasteExpo. Following February joint development agreement, the truck will test on California routes with Recology starting after the show.

new_news.headline: Notice of Lodging of Proposed Consent Decree Under the Clean Water Act—Fishing Vessel Bilge Water Discharge
new_news.summary: DOJ lodged a consent decree resolving alleged Clean Water Act violations involving discharge of oily bilge water from the fishing vessel Amelia Joyce into Fairhaven Harbor. Defendant required to pay $200,000 civil penalty for failures in pollution control equipment.

new_news.headline: Marine Grease Traps: How Vessels Manage FOG
new_news.summary: Article discusses FOG management onboard ships, comparing traditional passive grease traps with newer automatic grease removal systems like Marine Guardian AutoSkim. Focuses on continuous separation and removal technologies for vessel wastewater management.

new_news.headline: Why Darling Ingredients (DAR) Is Up 6.7% After Swinging Back to Profit in Q1 2026
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 results showing sales of US$1,550.82 million and net income of US$134.31 million, reversing a net loss and lifting earnings per share. The quarter marked a clear earnings inflection with stronger margins in core ingredients and the Diamond Green Diesel joint venture supported by favorable renewable fuel policy.
